newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela central bank to issue T-bills next week.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela central bank to issue T-bills next week.

text.p: Venezuela's central bank next week will likely begin to place a 450-billion-bolivar treasury bill issue aimed at reducing excess liquidity, the central bank's president, Antonio Casas Gonzalez, said Tuesday.
"It's very likely that they start to be issued next week. We need them," Casas told reporters at a ceremony to inaugurate the World Bank's new offices in Caracas.

The treasury bills, part of a plan to repay government debts with the central bank, would be issued alongside the bank's principal monetary instrument -- monetary stabilization, or TEM bills, he said.
Casas stressed the importance of the treasury bills to ease the burden on TEMs in efforts to soak up excess liquidity.
